## Fixed

- **Updates:** Larvyn now picks the newest release. GitHub can list releases out of order, so beta.9 said it was the newest and didn't offer beta.10. Version checks also ignore build metadata (`+…`), as semver says.

Everything from [beta.10](https://github.com/larvyn/releases/releases/tag/v0.1.0-beta.10), including plugins, is in this release.
